posts.author: Dailytrader
posts.text: Do You Think IT Companies Will Move Out of the Nifty 50? — The Indian IT sector is facing pressure from weaker global demand, AI-driven disruption and sector rotation toward financials, energy and consumer stocks. However, major IT companies are unlikely to exit the Nifty 50 solely because of underperformance. COBOL modernisation and AI services could create new growth opportunities, although traditional IT margins may come under pressure. The future outlook depends on earnings recovery, global technology spending and relative stock performance.
